text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the tryouts. Today,
race-ready Umamusume will display their
skills to prospective trainers in the
hopes
of being scouted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As for me, I'm also on the lookout for a
promising Umamusume to
scout and train.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
You're kidding. I just took a look at the
new pamphlet and I can't
believe my
eyes—Agnes Tachyon is entering!

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Huh, the Agnes Tachyon?! The one who's supposed to be as dangerous as she is talented?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A shiver runs down my spine as I recall
the
events of the other day.
However...

text_block_list.name: Tryouts Staff
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon, Agnes Tachyon?! That's weird...
Cafe, have you seen
Tachyon?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: W-what? Why would I have seen her...

text_block_list.name: Tryouts Staff
text_block_list.text: Whaaat? What should I do...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so Tachyon's a no-show again. Aw, I
wanted to see that
lightning-quick final
spurt of hers that everyone always talks
about.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Her grandmother won the Oaks, and her
mother the Oka Sho. Before she started at
Tracen, everyone was saying she was the
jewel of a
distinguished bloodline...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
But her eccentricity has put a bit of a
damper on that...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, Manhattan Cafe. Agnes
Tachyon is... not here, I take it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She should've received an official notice
from the academy telling her
that
participation in today's tryouts would be
mandatory.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
About that... I'm the one who told her the
teachers had something to discuss with her
the other day... I even saw her leave to
meet with
them... But, well...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Another absence... I see. Thank you, I
understand the situation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf's expression looks
strangely grim. Will Agnes Tachyon
be
okay ditching today's tryouts?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I leave the tryouts behind and start
searching for Agnes Tachyon's

whereabouts.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Oy... Whatcha doing loafin' around here,
Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A rare illogical query coming from you, my
dear Shakur. I, a student of this academy,
am standing on campus. Is there any
reason to inquire
about my intentions?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, that's not what I meant! Aren't you
registered for today's
tryouts?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ha-ha-ha! No need to be so grouchy! Are
your serotonin levels
getting low?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The answer is simple—I concluded that
there was no reason to enter.

Unfortunately, my goals do not coincide
with those of the tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the last time I entered, things
didn't end pretty. All those
trainers
swarmed me like guinea pigs to cabbage.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...That's just proof of how great you
are at
running.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The problem was, all of their training
schedules had excessive wastes of time.
Throwing invaluable research time down
the drain is beyond
me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trainers judge us Umamusume by their
own standards, so we should
be able to
screen them as well. Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Agh, you know what? Forget it! I've done
my part, so I'll be leaving.
Go and play
hooky all you like.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But just so you know... skipping class for
your experiments, ditching the tryouts,
and turning down every scouting offer—all
that means you
won't be able to debut.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
To be frank, you're standing on thin ice
with the academy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph.
She tells me to do as I like and then
ends with a warning...
Heh-heh, you really
are a delight, my dear Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? If it isn't the rookie trainer from
the
other day!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Are you here to become my test subject of
your own volition?! What
an amazing
display of guinea pig spirit! I'm moved
beyond words!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After desperately fending off an excited
Agnes Tachyon, I explain
why I'm here—to
get her to enter the tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so that's why. Alas,
I have not even an
inkling of desire to
participate.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Just as you trainers see the tryouts as a
place to discover promising talent to
scout, we Umamusume view it as an
opportunity to display
our talents.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, I see no reason to flaunt my
racing skills in front of trainers
at this time.
Therefore I will abstain. The end.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But on a more important note—why don't
we continue our experiment
where we left
off?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Last night, I completed a prototype device
that can measure muscle functions. Using
this, I can collect data a thousand times
more
detailed than—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Only through experiments can we discover
all manners of possibilities.
You can never
possess enough time for research—am I
wrong?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'm researching the potential of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: More specifically, the dormant physical potential within Umamusume as organisms. And by potential, I mean their top speed—no, what lies beyond that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
People view an Umamusume's top speed as
something definite, but common
knowledge is the enemy of progress.
Extrapolating without
preconception...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We recognize that the existence of us
Umamusume is an enigma in
itself, no?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Despite resembling humanity, we possess
high-functioning ears and
tails, as well as
inexplicable strength in spite of our low
muscle mass.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And when it comes to running, we can
achieve speeds almost
unrivaled within the
natural world.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Fascinating! Don't you think it's
fascinating?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In their essence, the impulses running
through my cerebral cortex are laughably
simple. How fast can we run? How far does
our potential
reach?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This I declare! With this body, I shall
discover the limits of our speed!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It's said that the fastest Umamusume are the ones who become race-ready—that is to say, their bodies are prepared to achieve the highest possible speeds of their lifetimes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In order to enhance my speed, entering
strenuous races and
challenging
formidable opponents will be
indispensable.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, qualifying for the Twinkle
Series would undoubtedly be a huge step
forward for my research. That is why I
came to the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But, alas—

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon. The academy would like
to have a word with you.
Come with me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, so they found me. Excuse me,
rookie trainer, but I must depart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon follows after the teacher,
and I can't help but get a
sinking feeling in
my stomach.
